cases.title: E1: an inactive terminal grant is retired by one durable event bound to the exact grant
E1: binding and input refusals append nothing
E2: a grant with an allocated or running execution cannot be retired
E2: an unresolved human request fails closed until it is answered
E2: repeat retirement is a deterministic refusal that appends no second event
E3: a retired grant is denied for inspection, allocation, retry, replacement and spawned work
E3: the unused budget of a retired grant stays unused and unusable
E4: the host operation is root-only, records one bound event and lists it
E4: manual, spawned, retry and automatic-continuation requests are refused before any work exists, across restart
E5: the host refuses retirement while work is active or a human decision is unresolved
E6: history is unchanged and a fresh successor grant operates normally after retirement

cases.reason: Existing supersession, recovery, correction, continuation and allocation-limit regressions are authoritative public tests; a hidden duplicate adds no falsifiability. Evidence plan is the differential procedure in eval-spec.md R1.
Identity and clean-commit binding is mechanical and has no executable product seam; evidence plan is eval-spec.md P1.
